title: pseudobulk_deseq2
description: Performs pseudobulk generation and subsequent differential expression analysis using DESeq2.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `/path/to/input_file.h5mu`

modality.description: Which modality from the input MuData file to process.

input_layer.description: Input layer to use. If None, X is used. This layer must contain raw counts.

obs_cell_group.description:
.obs field containing the variable to group on. Typically this field contains cell groups such as annotated cell types or clusters.
If provided, will generate DESeq2 analysis per cell group.

obs_groups.description: .obs fields containing the experimental condition(s) to create pseudobulk samples for.

var_gene_names.description: Name of the .var field that contains gene symbols. If not provided, .var.index will be used.

aggregation_method.description: Method to aggregate the raw counts for pseudoreplicates. Either sum or mean.

min_obs_per_sample.description: Minimum number of observations per pseudobulk sample.

filter_genes_min_samples.description:
Minimum number of samples a gene must be expressed in to be included in the analysis.
If None, no filtering is applied.

filter_gene_patterns.description:
List of regex patterns to filter out genes.
Genes matching any of these patterns will be excluded from the analysis.

design_formula.description:
Design formula for DESeq2 analysis in R-style format.
Specifies the statistical model to account for various factors.
design_formula.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, example: `~ cell_type + disease + treatment`

contrast_column.description:
Column in the metadata to use for the contrast.
This column should contain the conditions to compare.

contrast_values.description:
Values to compare in the contrast column.
First value is baseline, following values are different treatments.

p_adj_threshold.description:
Adjusted p-value threshold for significance.
Genes with adjusted p-values below this threshold will be considered significant.

log2fc_threshold.description:
Log2 fold change threshold for significance.
Genes with absolute log2 fold change above this threshold will be considered significant.

output.description: Output directory for DESeq2 results, containing one CSV file per cell group (as defined by `--obs_cell_group`)

output_prefix.description: Prefix for output CSV files: files will be named "{prefix}_{cell_group}.csv"

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
